transcript: Make a bill splitting app for a trip with four friends. I want to log who paid how much, and at the end show who owes whom how much to settle up
Make a shopping list. Let me add things to buy, check them off right in the list when I buy them, and only show what I haven't bought yet
A shift tracker for my part-time job. When I enter the date and my start and end times, work out the hours automatically, and show how much I'm making this month at 15 dollars an hour
A workout log. I want to record the day and how long I ran or lifted, and see how many times I worked out this week and my total minutes this month
A reading log. Let me add books when I finish them, and show how many I've read this year and how many more I need to hit my goal of 50 books a year
A medicine checklist. Let me add the pills I take every day, check them off in the list when I take them, and show how many I've taken today
Track my spending on my favorite band. Log it by category like merch, tickets and travel, and show how much I spent this month and what's left of my 300 dollar monthly budget
A weight tracker. I'm 170 centimeters tall. When I log my weight every day, calculate my BMI, and show a chart of how it changes
A habit tracker. Every day I check off whether I worked out and read, and it shows how many days in a row I've kept it up
An exam study planner. Show the number of days left until the exam in big text, let me log study time for each subject, and track my progress toward a goal of 20 hours
Make a budget app with three tabs: Log, Chart and Settings. In Settings I set my monthly budget, and on the Log screen I can see how much of this month's budget is left
A plant watering app. Set how often each plant needs water, figure out the next watering date from the last time I watered it, and tell me which plants need water today
